description_blocks.text: Introduction

The Magnetic Levitation DIY Kit combines science with creativity, unlocking the unique charm of magnetic levitation technology. It includes a base, a floating module and a power supply, enabling objects to float smoothly in mid-air and creating an enchanting floating effect. With easy assembly and durable construction, the kit transforms complex magnetic levitation technology into an accessible DIY experience, allowing you to easily step into the wonderful world of magnetic levitation and create stunning floating displays.

Whether you’re a DIY hobbyist, tech enthusiast, or someone who loves unique decor, this kit lets you bring futuristic charm to any space. Transform collectible figures, mini moon lamps, custom 3D-printed creations, or even small keepsakes into eye-catching desktop centerpieces—there’s no limit to what you can create. The sleek, tech-inspired design adds a modern touch to offices, bedrooms, or workspaces, making it both a fun project and a standout decoration.
PrintMon Maker Edition

The PrintMon Maker Edition includes two bags of steel balls to help balance the weight of your 3D-printed creations, ensuring perfect stability. If your design requires weight adjustments for balance, consider selecting the Magnetic Levitation DIY Kit (PrintMon Maker Edition).
Frequently Asked Questions
Stability depends on the model's center of gravity. A lower center of gravity and closer alignment with the float increase weight capacity and stability.
A simple way to make your model levitate is by directly placing or attaching it to the float.
If you'd like the levitating part to look more aesthetically pleasing, you can refer to the creation guide for methods to modify your model using the Boolean tool in the 3D files.

This product is intended for ages 14 and up and is not suitable for use in any children's products, toys, or household items intended for children. This product contains small parts and poses a choking hazard. Do not ingest. If accidentally swallowed, seek immediate medical attention. Keep out of reach of children.
Contains strong magnetic materials. Avoid using the kit near individuals with pacemakers.
Use only the included power adapter to prevent damage.
Review the manual first to grasp the device’s complexity before assembly.
Handle the float with care to avoid impact damage, its 3D-printed shell offers initial protection.
Handle the touch switch connections carefully during wiring to avoid damage.
Avoid touching the sensitive side of the touch switch to prevent electrostatic damage.
Handle the coil wires carefully by placing them in the top cover’s notch when reinstalling the protective shell to prevent damage.
Clear all metal objects within a 20cm radius and try again. Keep the float level as you lower it.
Do not adjust the mechanism’s blue knob; let the base cool if overheated. Both may prevent levitation.
Use the auxiliary bracket from the 3D Model files if needed.
If levitation fails repeatedly, check for magnet detachment (look for adhesive residue) and discontinue use if detached.
NEVER attach uncertified substitute magnets (may cause magnetic field overload).
High power consumption for misaligned models may cause the system to overheat, leading to a drop. Adjust the balance for better performance.
These phenomena are normal and do not affect the product's functionality.
Magnets on the coil: They are intentionally designed to compensate for minor magnetic variations in the electromagnet. Please avoid base impacts during operation.
Yellow/Black discoloration on the white plastic piece: The plastic protects magnets from impacts, and the discoloration is laser cutting residue.

Frequently Asked Questions

Stability depends on the model's center of gravity. A lower center of gravity and closer alignment with the float increase weight capacity and stability.

A simple way to make your model levitate is by directly placing or attaching it to the float.

If you'd like the levitating part to look more aesthetically pleasing, you can refer to the creation guide for methods to modify your model using the Boolean tool in the 3D files.

This product is intended for ages 14 and up and is not suitable for use in any children's products, toys, or household items intended for children.
This product contains small parts and poses a choking hazard. Do not ingest. If accidentally swallowed, seek immediate medical attention. Keep out of reach of children.

Contains strong magnetic materials. Avoid using the kit near individuals with pacemakers.

Use only the included power adapter to prevent damage.

Review the manual first to grasp the device’s complexity before assembly.

Handle the float with care to avoid impact damage, its 3D-printed shell offers initial protection.

Handle the touch switch connections carefully during wiring to avoid damage.

Avoid touching the sensitive side of the touch switch to prevent electrostatic damage.

Handle the coil wires carefully by placing them in the top cover’s notch when reinstalling the protective shell to prevent damage.

Clear all metal objects within a 20cm radius and try again. Keep the float level as you lower it.

Do not adjust the mechanism’s blue knob; let the base cool if overheated. Both may prevent levitation.

Use the auxiliary bracket from the 3D Model files if needed.

If levitation fails repeatedly, check for magnet detachment (look for adhesive residue) and discontinue use if detached.

NEVER attach uncertified substitute magnets (may cause magnetic field overload) .

High power consumption for misaligned models may cause the system to overheat, leading to a drop. Adjust the balance for better performance.

These phenomena are normal and do not affect the product's functionality.

Magnets on the coil: They are intentionally designed to compensate for minor magnetic variations in the electromagnet. Please avoid base impacts during operation.

Yellow/Black discoloration on the white plastic piece: The plastic protects magnets from impacts, and the discoloration is laser cutting residue.
